info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Auto Insurance Quotes Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Auto Insurance Quotes Status API allows users to check the current status of their auto insurance quotes. This resource is essential for insurance agents and policyholders who need timely updates on the processing of their quotes. By utilizing this API, users can easily track progress, anticipate coverage commencement, and manage client expectations effectively. The API is designed to facilitate seamless communication regarding insurance quotes, enabling efficient operations within insurance platforms.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of quotes.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of quotes, providing insights into the processing and approval stages. It is designed for developers looking to integrate quote status checking into their applications efficiently.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of quotes. It can include various filtering parameters to specify the criteria for fetching the quote statuses.

200.description: The request was successful, and the current status of quotes is returned.
